about: A demand paid against a cone stays paid while what the cone renders is the same: a new byte digest with an equal leaf moves nothing.
A view that writes a leaf is paid while its leaf is what it would write, and is open the moment it is not.

cases.name: a leaf that renders the same
a leaf that differs from its render
a view that writes no leaf
cases.demand: paid by its receipt, as before

red was: four views whose leaves were SAME stood missing because no receipt had vouched a hidden leaf
